integrity: Finite numerical checks reproduce consequences of an analytical proof, not a computer-assisted infinite certificate. The published n=2 and regular-cap coverage cases are credited.
scientific_limitations: Known circular orbit, isotropic orientation and initial phase, ideal geometric projected-separation detection, no flux, noise, uncertain ephemerides, eccentricity, or multiple-detection requirement. Possible priority overlap with general circular covering and equatorial spherical-cap theorems; no independent historical validation.
title: Exact optimal multivisit completeness for circular exoplanet direct imaging
